_meanings:
.²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the physician of the gods, said to have been produced at the
 churning of the ocean with a cup of nectar in his hand; <ab>cf.</ab> {#caturdaSaratna#}.
.²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the nine Ratnas at the court of Vikramāditya.
.²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a deity to whom oblations were offered to the North-east quarter; <ls>Ms. 3. 85</ls>.
.²4 <ab>N.</ab> of the sun; <ls>Mb. 3. 3. 25</ls>.
